label: Ubiquiti UniFi U7 Pro Outdoor
description: Outdoor Wi-Fi 7 access point with one 1/2.5 GbE port, pole or wall mount.
notes: Vendor figures from the Ubiquiti tech specs page: Networking Interface **(1) 1/2.5 GbE RJ45 port**, wind loading 74.6 N at 200 km/h, pole mount 25-63.5 mm, UV-stabilised polycarbonate and aluminium. The **2.5G port is required** to make Wi-Fi 7 worthwhile - the same AP behind a gigabit port tops out at 1 Gbps of real traffic. Radio rates are modelled at Wi-Fi 7 class (688M on 2.4 GHz, 2.9G on 6 GHz) because the per-band rows were not in the extracted section.
